employee_compensation.description: Employee master table storing personal profiles, statutory contribution configurations (EPF, SOCSO, EIS, tax, zakat, HRDF), banking details, work schedule settings, and payroll flags. Referenced by payroll processing and HR analytics queries.

employee_general.description: Core employee master table storing personal demographics, identification documents, contact details, employment lifecycle dates, organizational assignment (branch/division/department/section), and emergency contacts. Primary reference table joined by employee_no across HR modules.

V_TMS_OVERTIME.description: Time management daily attendance and overtime records per employee. Each row represents one calendar day. The Indicator column contains Absent when the employee was absent; count non-null Indicator values to compute absent days. Use actual_date for date filtering and employee_no to join with V_EMP.

employee_leave_hd.description: Header record for a leave application submission. One header row maps to one employee_leave row (1:1) — employee_leave.hd_id references employee_leave_hd.id. A related table, employee_leave_dt, holds further per-day breakdown but is not exposed via this API. submit_by/submit_date and the process_* fields are frequently NULL in practice — use create_by/create_date to identify who submitted the application and when. Query this table to check approval status before creating the employee_leave record. Required for create: employee_no.

fields.name: cancel_id

fields.name: create_by

fields.name: create_date

fields.name: document_id

fields.name: employee_no

fields.name: submit_date

employee_leave.description: Employee leave application record — one row per leave request. Join on employee_no to V_EMP for employee details, on leave_code to employee_leave_entitlement for balance checking before creating a new request, and on hd_id to employee_leave_hd for the submission/approval header (1:1). When creating a record, required fields are: hd_id, employee_no, leave_code, date_from, date_to, days, status, emergency, period_type_from, period_type_to. The status field controls workflow: 'P'=Pending, 'A'=Approved, 'R'=Rejected, 'C'=Cancelled. Leave-type-specific fields (mc_type, clinic_name, hospital_name, child_name, etc.) are only relevant when leave_code matches the corresponding type.

fields.name: approved_by
fields.description: User ID or employee_no of the approver who approved/rejected this leave. Null when status is still Pending.

fields.name: approved_date
fields.description: Timestamp when the leave was approved or rejected. Null when status is Pending.

fields.name: cert_date_issued
fields.description: Date a medical certificate was issued. Only relevant for sick leave (leave_code=MCL or HOS).

fields.name: cert_ref_no
fields.description: Medical certificate reference number. Only relevant for sick leave (leave_code=MCL or HOS).

fields.name: child_birthdate
fields.description: Child's birth date. Only relevant for maternity/childcare leave (leave_code=MAT, CL).

fields.name: child_citizen
fields.description: Child's citizenship. Only relevant for maternity leave (leave_code=MAT).

fields.name: child_count
fields.description: Number of children. Only relevant for maternity/childcare leave.

fields.name: child_name
fields.description: Child's name. Only relevant for maternity/childcare leave (leave_code=MAT, CL).

fields.name: clinic_name
fields.description: Name of clinic visited. Only relevant for outpatient sick leave (leave_code=MCL).

fields.name: create_by
fields.description: System user ID who created this record.

fields.name: create_date
fields.description: Record creation timestamp.

fields.name: date_from
fields.description: Leave start date (inclusive). Required for create. NOT NULL.

fields.name: date_to
fields.description: Leave end date (inclusive). Required for create. NOT NULL.

fields.name: days
fields.description: Total leave days applied. Supports decimal for half-day leaves (e.g. 0.5). Required for create.

fields.name: death_cert
fields.description: Death certificate reference number. Only relevant for compassionate/bereavement leave (leave_code=COM).

fields.name: deceased_date
fields.description: Date of death of the deceased person. Only relevant for compassionate leave (leave_code=COM).

fields.name: divorce_ref_no
fields.description: Divorce certificate reference number. Only relevant for special divorce-related leave.

fields.name: document_id
fields.description: Attachment/document ID linking to uploaded supporting documents.

fields.name: emergency
fields.description: Whether this is an emergency leave application. 'Y'=Yes, 'N'=No. Required for create.

fields.name: employee_no
fields.description: Employee number (FK to V_EMP.EMPLOYEE_NO). Identifies who is applying for leave. Required for create. NOT NULL.

fields.name: family_name
fields.description: Family member name. Only relevant for compassionate/family-related leave (leave_code=COM).

fields.name: hd_id
fields.description: FK to employee_leave_hd.id — links this leave detail line to its submission/approval header. Required for create: an employee_leave_hd row must be created first. NOT NULL.

fields.name: hospital_name
fields.description: Name of hospital visited. Only relevant for hospitalization sick leave (leave_code=HOS).

fields.name: id
fields.description: Auto-increment primary key. Do not set on create. NOT NULL.

fields.name: leave_code
fields.description: Type of leave (e.g. ANL=Annual, MCL=Medical Clinic, MAT=Maternity, COM=Compassionate, UPL=Unpaid). Query codesetup entity WHERE type='Leave Type' for the canonical list — note actual codes are tenant-specific and may not exactly match the generic seed list. Required for create. NOT NULL.

fields.name: mc_type
fields.description: Medical certificate type classification. Only relevant for sick leave (leave_code=MCL or HOS).

fields.name: modify_by
fields.description: System user ID who last modified this record.

fields.name: modify_date
fields.description: Last modification timestamp.

fields.name: period_type_from
fields.description: Day period for leave start. 1=Full day, 2=Half day (AM), 3=Half day (PM). Required for create. NOT NULL.

fields.name: period_type_to
fields.description: Day period for leave end. 1=Full day, 2=Half day (AM), 3=Half day (PM). Required for create. NOT NULL.

fields.name: reason_code
fields.description: Reason code for the leave application. Query codesetup entity for valid values.

fields.name: relation_type
fields.description: Relationship to the person involved (e.g. for compassionate leave: spouse, parent, child).

fields.name: reliever_no
fields.description: Employee number of the designated reliever covering duties during this leave (FK to V_EMP.EMPLOYEE_NO).

fields.name: remarks
fields.description: Free-text remarks or notes about this leave application.

fields.name: replacement_date
fields.description: The date for which this replacement leave was earned (e.g. the rest day or public holiday that was worked).

fields.name: rpl_leave_id
fields.description: References the original leave record ID that this replacement leave is compensating for.

fields.name: sickness_type
fields.description: Category of illness. Only relevant for sick leave (leave_code=MCL or HOS).

fields.name: status
fields.description: Approval status. 'P'=Pending, 'A'=Approved, 'R'=Rejected, 'C'=Cancelled. Required for create. NOT NULL.

fields.name: submission_date
fields.description: Date and time the employee submitted this leave application. NOT NULL.

fields.name: ValidFrom
fields.description: Temporal validity start for this record (SCD pattern).

fields.name: ValidTo
fields.description: Temporal validity end for this record (SCD pattern).

employee_leave_entitlement.description: Per-employee leave entitlement and balance tracking. Each row represents one leave type allocation for one employee within an effective date range (typically one calendar year). The available balance formula is: leave_ent + leave_bf - forfeit + adjustment. Query this entity to check remaining balance before approving leave in employee_leave. Join on employee_no to V_EMP, and on leave_code to codesetup (type='LEAVE_CODE') for descriptions. Filter by effective_from/effective_to to get the current year's entitlement.

fields.name: adjustment
fields.description: Manual adjustment amount (positive or negative decimal). Added to the balance. Used by HR to correct entitlements (e.g. +1.0 for ad-hoc extra day, -2.0 for deduction).

fields.name: create_by
fields.description: System user ID who created this entitlement record.

fields.name: create_date
fields.description: Record creation timestamp.

fields.name: effective_from
fields.description: Start date of this entitlement period (inclusive). Usually Jan 1 of the calendar year, e.g. 2014-01-01. NOT NULL.

fields.name: effective_to
fields.description: End date of this entitlement period (inclusive). Usually Dec 31 of the calendar year, e.g. 2014-12-31. NOT NULL.

fields.name: employee_no
fields.description: Employee number (FK to V_EMP.EMPLOYEE_NO). Required for create. NOT NULL.

fields.name: entitlement_type
fields.description: Entitlement category. 'Y'=Yearly/annual entitlement. Other values may indicate prorated or one-time allocations. NOT NULL.

fields.name: forfeit
fields.description: Number of days forfeited (non-negative decimal). Typically applied when brought-forward leave exceeds the maximum carry-forward limit.

fields.name: id
fields.description: Auto-increment primary key. Do not set on create. NOT NULL.

fields.name: leave_bf
fields.description: Brought-forward balance from the previous period (non-negative decimal). This is the unused leave carried over into the current entitlement period.

fields.name: leave_code
fields.description: Leave type code (e.g. ANL=Annual, MCL=Medical Clinic, MAT=Maternity, COM=Compassionate, UPL=Unpaid). Query codesetup entity WHERE type='LEAVE_CODE' for full list. Required for create. NOT NULL.

fields.name: leave_ent
fields.description: Total allocated entitlement days for this leave type in this period (non-negative decimal). This is the gross allocation before deducting forfeit or adding adjustment. NOT NULL.

fields.name: modify_by
fields.description: System user ID who last modified this record.

fields.name: modify_date
fields.description: Last modification timestamp.

fields.name: remarks
fields.description: Free-text notes about this entitlement (e.g. reason for adjustment).

fields.name: ValidFrom
fields.description: Temporal validity start for this record (SCD pattern).

fields.name: ValidTo
fields.description: Temporal validity end for this record (SCD pattern).

v_employee_leave_entitlement.description: Simplified per-employee leave entitlement view by leave type and calendar year. Each row shows the allocated entitlement, brought-forward, forfeited, and adjusted days for one employee and one leave type in a single year. Use this for quick balance lookups without temporal validity columns.

fields.name: employee_no
fields.description: Employee number (FK to V_EMP.EMPLOYEE_NO). Primary identifier for joining.

fields.name: leave_code
fields.description: Leave type code (e.g. ANL=Annual, MCL=Medical Clinic, MAT=Maternity, COM=Compassionate, UPL=Unpaid). Query codesetup entity WHERE type='LEAVE_CODE' for full list.

fields.name: year
fields.description: Calendar year this entitlement applies to.

fields.name: leave_ent
fields.description: Total allocated entitlement days for this leave type and year (decimal).

fields.name: leave_bf
fields.description: Brought-forward balance from previous year (decimal).

fields.name: forfeit
fields.description: Days forfeited due to carry-forward limits (decimal).

fields.name: adjustment
fields.description: Manual adjustment amount (decimal). Positive for additions, negative for deductions.

v_employee_leave_summary.description: Aggregated leave summary view per employee, leave type, and year. Combines entitlement, brought-forward, adjustments, and actual usage (approved, pending, rejected, taken) into a single row for dashboard and balance-checking queries. Use this for 'how many days do I have left' questions instead of computing from raw tables.

fields.name: employee_no
fields.description: Employee number (FK to V_EMP.EMPLOYEE_NO).

fields.name: date_joined
fields.description: Employee's original joining date.

fields.name: date_resigned
fields.description: Employee's resignation date, null if currently active.

fields.name: leave_code
fields.description: Leave type code.

fields.name: leave_description
fields.description: Human-readable description of the leave type.

fields.name: leave_type
fields.description: Leave type category code (e.g. OT, ADP, CCL, MTSG, UPIC, UP).

fields.name: year
fields.description: Calendar year this summary applies to.

fields.name: leave_ent
fields.description: Total entitlement days allocated for this year.

fields.name: c_leave_ent
fields.description: Current or revised entitlement after mid-year changes.

fields.name: YTDent
fields.description: Year-to-date entitlement accrued.

fields.name: leave_bf
fields.description: Brought-forward balance from previous year.

fields.name: forfeit
fields.description: Days forfeited this year.

fields.name: adjustment
fields.description: Manual adjustment applied this year.

fields.name: totalapprove
fields.description: Total approved leave days across all statuses for this year.

fields.name: totalpending
fields.description: Total pending leave days awaiting approval.

fields.name: totalreject
fields.description: Total rejected leave days.

fields.name: totaltaken
fields.description: Total leave days already taken/consumed.

fields.name: YTDapprove
fields.description: Year-to-date approved leave days.

fields.name: resigntaken
fields.description: Leave days taken during resignation notice period.

fields.name: yearlybalance
fields.description: Remaining balance for the full year: leave_ent + leave_bf - forfeit + adjustment - totaltaken.

fields.name: YTDbalance
fields.description: Year-to-date remaining balance.
